Neither path is in this task's FILES nor in any sibling's, so no edit inside this tree answers it — the plan allocated `fleet/CONTRACT.md` and `fleet/RUNBOOK.md` only. Note also that `fleet/tests/test_sandbox_boot_selfmerge.mjs`'s M7 leg was loosened from `/A ready PR merges itself once its checks are green.../` to `/A ready PR merges itself.../`, so after this diff nothing pins SKILL.md's sentence at all; the loosening was not forced (the BASE assertion still passes against the unchanged SKILL.md). This matters concretely for THIS diff, which changes the fold-again loop and the body patch: `patch_pr_body` is moved out of the `attempt > 1` block and given a second trigger (`case "$MERGE_NOTE" in "left open: suite red"*`), and the two cases that pinned it — `a disposition that lands after the POST is PATCHed onto the body` and `a one-attempt run sends no PATCH at all` — go out with the file. After this patch nothing in the committed suite asserts how many PATCHes a green run, a fold-again run, or a held run sends; the held legs read `pr-body.md` off the evidence worktree, not the PATCH payload. With Acceptance being "the committed suite is the verification", that is a real hole.

Fix inside this task's FILES: keep the file (or re-home its second half).
